push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 8.8 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.8 against unbeatables FC. The other team's gonna be talking about you on the drive home.

DID WELL
+ 26 passes, your busiest match yet. You were the heartbeat in the middle.
+ Won 4 of 8 tackles (up from your usual 26%). Clean as a whistle and twice as loud.
+ 8 tackles attempted (up from your usual 4). Defending is a choice, and you chose it every time.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. That's an award you earned, not one they handed you.

WORK ON
- 50% passing (13 of 26, down from your usual 58%). Golden rule: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

Coach's drill: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 59% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 2 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 0 goals from 4 shots on target - the keeper is getting to them
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.
Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
weaknesses.coach: You're hitting the target, so now let's beat the keeper.

push.title: D 2-2 vs unbeatables FC | You: 7.2 (below average MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.2 against unbeatables FC. You were close to a good one. Let's find the missing piece.

DID WELL
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ You and PhogsToffees turned simple passes into goals.
+ 2-2 draw. Neither team blinked.

WORK ON
- 59% passing (10 of 17, down from your usual 81%). Here's the trick: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- 0 goals from 4 on target. Focus point: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.
- 0.7 below your typical game. Next one's the bounce-back.
- Passes attempted: 17. 25+ is the gold standard for a midfielder.

Muscle memory: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but they were laying bricks every hour. - Coach Lasso
